introduction: The draft feature exercises a spec that is still in the draft lifecycle state.

glossary.draft: The lifecycle state a spec is in before its intent is hashed.

requirements.title: Draft lifecycle
requirements.rationale: A draft must stay editable until its intent is agreed.

criteria.condition: a spec is in the draft state
criteria.action: allow every field of the PRD to be edited and saved

criteria.condition: a transition to a state outside the lifecycle graph is requested
criteria.action: reject the transition and leave the spec unchanged
criteria.contract: a LifecycleError naming the current and target states

execution_paths.title: An operator edits a draft spec

steps.action: edits the Intent section of prd.md
saves the spec and leaves the intent hash null
